title: "Fig4-step1-eQTL_Plotting_Analysis_scgal.1"
output: html_document

**Update 2026-10-21: clumping now uses PLINK 1.9 `--clump`, run separately for every gene**
(`plink_clump_per_gene()` in `shared_code/ld_clump_and_local.R`; `--clump-p1 1 --clump-p2 1
--clump-r2 0.6 --clump-kb 50`; PLINK from `module load bioinformatics/20260810`). It replaces the
R implementation of 2026-10-16 (on the YPD.1 data the two gave identical clumps for 1394 of 1422
genes with >1 variant); the clumped files are now `clumped_*_plink_per_gene_r2_0.6_50kb.tsv`.

**Update 2026-10-16: per-gene LD clumping and local/distant eQTLs.**

- *Clumping.* Significant variants are now grouped into one signal **separately for every gene**
  (r2 > 0.6, within 50 kb), in R (`shared_code/ld_clump_and_local.R`). The earlier PLINK
  clumping (`--clump-kb 2`) was run on all genes at once (the PLINK input had no gene column),
  so a variant could be removed because a nearby variant was a stronger eQTL for another gene,
  and its 2-kb window was shorter than the LD in these strains. The 50-kb window comes from the
  LD decay of the 96 strains (`LD_decay_96_strains.Rmd`: half-decay 0.7 kb, but pairs with
  r2 > 0.6 stay above background up to ~50 kb).
- *Local / distant eQTLs.* Local = any variant of the gene's clump within 25 kb of the gene
  (either side); SVs: the SV span; translocations: either breakpoint; gene-based CNVs: the CNV's gene
  start (same 25-kb rule since 2026-10-23; was: local only when CNV and gene are the same ORF). All other eQTLs are distant. The figures below use
  local/distant. The older cis/trans call (lead variant within 2 kb; column `cis_trans`) is kept
  in the tables and in the cis/trans map of panel A (Step2).
- The annotated tables keep their file names (`*_annotated_cis_trans.txt`) and gain the columns
  `local_distant`, `local_distance_bp`, `clump_n_members`, `clump_members`.

# Part 1: Load annotation reference data
```{r annotation-reference}
# ===================================================================
# Section 1: Load shared annotation reference
# ===================================================================

ann <- read.csv(ANNOT_CSV)
annotations_gr <- GRanges(ann$seqnames,
                          IRanges(ann$start, ann$end),
                          strand  = ann$strand,
                          type    = ann$type,
                          gene_id = ann$gene_id,
                          gene_name = ann$gene_name)

roman16 <- c("I","II","III","IV","V","VI","VII","VIII",
             "IX","X","XI","XII","XIII","XIV","XV","XVI")
num_to_roman <- function(x) roman16[x]

chr_lengths <- c(I=230218, II=813184, III=316620, IV=1531933, V=576874, VI=270161,
                 VII=1090940, VIII=562643, IX=439888, X=745751, XI=666816,
                 XII=1078177, XIII=924431, XIV=784333, XV=1091291, XVI=948066)

gene_location_fixed <- read.table(GENE_LOC, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name, chr, left, right) %>%
  mutate(right = right + 2,
         gene_id = str_replace(gene_id, "-", "."))

# feature priority for the representative-feature pick (promoter first ... CDS last)
feature_priority <- c(promoter = 1, three_prime_UTR = 2, five_prime_UTR = 3,
                      start_codon = 4, stop_codon = 5, CDS = 6)
prio <- function(f) { p <- feature_priority[f]; p[is.na(p)] <- 99; p }

cat("✓ Annotation reference data loaded.\n\n")
```

# Part 2: Annotation helper functions
```{r annot-helpers}
# ===================================================================
# Section 2: Annotation functions
# ===================================================================

assign_nearest <- function(df, gr) {
  m <- which(is.na(df$Causal_Gene))
  if (length(m)) {
    ng <- nearest(gr[m], annotations_gr); ok <- !is.na(ng)
    d  <- rep(NA_real_, length(m))
    d[ok] <- distance(gr[m][ok], annotations_gr[ng[ok]])
    near <- !is.na(d) & d <= CIS_WINDOW_BP
    df$Causal_Gene[m[near]]          <- annotations_gr$gene_id[ng[near]]
    df$Causal_Gene_feature[m[near]]  <- "intergenic_nearby"
    df$Causal_Gene_feature[m[!near]] <- "intergenic_distant"
  }
  df
}

annotate_point <- function(df, pick = c("priority","first")) {
  pick <- match.arg(pick)
  df$Variant_Chr <- num_to_roman(df$Chr)
  gr <- GRanges(df$Variant_Chr, IRanges(df$ChrPos, df$ChrPos))
  df$Causal_Gene <- NA_character_; df$Causal_Gene_feature <- NA_character_
  ov <- findOverlaps(gr, annotations_gr, type = "any")
  for (i in unique(queryHits(ov))) {
    subj <- subjectHits(ov)[queryHits(ov) == i]
    k <- if (pick == "priority") subj[which.min(prio(annotations_gr$type[subj]))] else subj[1]
    df$Causal_Gene[i]         <- annotations_gr$gene_id[k]
    df$Causal_Gene_feature[i] <- annotations_gr$type[k]
  }
  assign_nearest(df, gr)
}

annotate_range <- function(df, range_end, use_nearest) {
  df$Variant_Chr <- num_to_roman(df$Chr)
  gr <- GRanges(df$Variant_Chr, IRanges(pmin(df$ChrPos, range_end), pmax(df$ChrPos, range_end)))
  df$Causal_Gene <- NA_character_; df$Causal_Gene_feature <- NA_character_
  ov <- findOverlaps(gr, annotations_gr, type = "any")
  for (i in unique(queryHits(ov))) {
    subj <- subjectHits(ov)[queryHits(ov) == i]
    df$Causal_Gene[i]         <- paste(unique(annotations_gr$gene_id[subj]), collapse = "; ")
    df$Causal_Gene_feature[i] <- paste(unique(annotations_gr$type[subj]),   collapse = "; ")
  }
  if (use_nearest) {
    df <- assign_nearest(df, gr)
  } else {
    df$Causal_Gene_feature[is.na(df$Causal_Gene)] <- "intergenic_distant"
  }
  df
}

annotate_variant <- function(df, vt) {
  if (vt == "SNPs") {
    df <- annotate_point(df, "priority")
    df$Variant_subtype <- "SNP"
    return(df)
  }
  if (vt == "CNVs") {
    # Gene-based CNV marker IDs are <gene>_Cov<threshold>: a below/above split
    # of the gene's normalized depth (1 = normal copy number). Thresholds < 1
    # mark copy-number loss, > 1 gain. ChrPos is the gene start.
    # Chr 17 (unplaced gene families) is removed in read_assoc(); positions
    # past the S288C chromosome end (non-reference subtelomeric families) have
    # no reference coordinates and are removed here.
    df <- df[df$ChrPos <= chr_lengths[num_to_roman(df$Chr)], ]
    df$Variant_Chr     <- num_to_roman(df$Chr)
    df$CNV_gene        <- sub("_Cov[0-9.]+$", "", df$SNP)
    df$Cov_threshold   <- as.numeric(sub("^.*_Cov", "", df$SNP))
    df$Variant_subtype <- ifelse(df$Cov_threshold < 1, "Loss", "Gain")
    # The affected gene is the CNV gene itself (its copy number changes), so
    # no overlap search is needed.
    df$Causal_Gene         <- df$CNV_gene
    df$Causal_Gene_feature <- "CDS"
    return(df)
  }
  if (vt == "InDels") {
    p <- strsplit(df$SNP, "_")
    ref_len <- vapply(p, function(x) nchar(x[3]), 1L)
    alt_len <- vapply(p, function(x) nchar(x[4]), 1L)
    size <- alt_len - ref_len
    df$Variant_subtype <- ifelse(size >= 0, "INS", "DEL")
    range_end <- ifelse(size < 0, df$ChrPos + ref_len - 1, df$ChrPos)
    return(annotate_range(df, range_end, use_nearest = FALSE))
  }
  if (vt == "SVs") {
    toks <- strsplit(df$SNP, "_")
    df$Variant_subtype <- vapply(toks, function(x) if (length(x) >= 2) x[2] else "Unknown", "")
    sz <- vapply(toks, function(x){ i <- which(x == "len"); if (length(i)) as.numeric(x[i+1]) else NA_real_ }, 0)
    range_end <- ifelse(df$Variant_subtype %in% c("INS","TRA"), df$ChrPos, df$ChrPos + abs(sz))
    range_end[is.na(range_end)] <- df$ChrPos[is.na(range_end)]
    return(annotate_range(df, range_end, use_nearest = TRUE))
  }
  stop("unknown variant type: ", vt)
}

add_cis_trans <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    left_join(gene_location_fixed, by = c("Pheno" = "gene_id")) %>%
    mutate(
      Pheno_chr   = chr,
      Pheno_start = left,
      Pheno_end   = right,
      dist_to_pheno = case_when(
        Variant_Chr != Pheno_chr ~ NA_real_,
        ChrPos < Pheno_start ~ Pheno_start - ChrPos,
        ChrPos > Pheno_end   ~ ChrPos - Pheno_end,
        TRUE ~ 0),
      cis_trans = case_when(
        Variant_Chr != Pheno_chr ~ "Trans",
        dist_to_pheno == 0    ~ "Cis",
        dist_to_pheno <= CIS_WINDOW_BP ~ "Cis",
        # Pheno IDs use "." where gene IDs use "-" (e.g. YBL029C.A)
        str_replace_all(Causal_Gene, "-", ".") == Pheno ~ "Cis",
        TRUE                  ~ "Trans"))
}

# Read one variant type's association file. Gene-based CNV markers on
# chromosome 17 (unplaced, non-reference gene families) are removed, so they
# are not clumped, annotated or plotted.
read_assoc <- function(vt) {
  d <- read.table(variant_cfg[[vt]]$assoc, header = TRUE, sep = "\t",
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (vt == "CNVs") d <- d[d$Chr != 17, ]
  d
}

cat("✓ Annotation functions loaded.\n\n")
```

# Part 3: Per-gene LD clumping + annotation
```{r clump-and-annotate}
# ===================================================================
# Section 3: per-gene LD clumping (cached per variant type), annotation, local/distant
# ===================================================================
original_data <- setNames(lapply(names(variant_cfg), read_assoc), names(variant_cfg))

# 1) clump each gene's significant variants with PLINK --clump (r2 CLUMP_R2 within CLUMP_KB kb)
clumps <- lapply(setNames(names(variant_cfg), names(variant_cfg)), function(vt) {
  f <- variant_cfg[[vt]]$clumped
  if (file.exists(f)) return(as.data.frame(fread(f)))
  a  <- original_data[[vt]][, c("Pheno", "SNP", "Chr", "ChrPos", "PValue")]
  cl <- plink_clump_per_gene(a, variant_cfg[[vt]]$geno,
                             file.path(OUT_CLUMP, paste0("plink_per_gene_", vt)))
  fwrite(cl, f, sep = "\t")
  cl
})
cat("Per-gene PLINK clumping (r2", CLUMP_R2, "within", CLUMP_KB, "kb):\n")
for (vt in names(clumps))
  cat(sprintf("  %-6s %5d significant associations -> %5d clumps (%d genes)\n", vt,
              nrow(original_data[[vt]]), nrow(clumps[[vt]]), n_distinct(clumps[[vt]]$Pheno)))

# translocation partner breakpoints (for the local call of TRA SVs)
tra_partners <- read_tra_partners(original_data$SVs$SNP)

# 2) keep the index variant of every clump, annotate, classify cis/trans and local/distant
annotated <- lapply(setNames(names(variant_cfg), names(variant_cfg)), function(vt) {
  original_data[[vt]] %>%
    semi_join(clumps[[vt]], by = c("Pheno", "SNP")) %>%
    annotate_variant(vt) %>%
    add_cis_trans() %>%
    add_local_distant(clumps[[vt]], original_data[[vt]], vt, tra_partners) %>%
    mutate(Genetic_variants = vt)
})

# 3) save (same file names as before; new columns local_distant, local_distance_bp, clump_*)
out_names <- c(SNPs = "snp_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt",
               CNVs = "cnv_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt",
               InDels = "indel_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt",
               SVs = "sv_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt")
for (vt in names(annotated)) {
  fwrite(annotated[[vt]], file.path(PREV_ANALYSIS, "annotations", out_names[[vt]]),
         sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
  cat("  Saved", out_names[[vt]], "-", nrow(annotated[[vt]]), "rows\n")
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Combined table for all figures (Location = local / distant)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_clumped <- bind_rows(lapply(annotated, function(d) {
  d %>% select(any_of(c("Genetic_variants","SNP","Variant_Chr","ChrPos","Pheno","Pheno_chr",
                        "PValue","SnpWeight","EffectSize","Causal_Gene","Causal_Gene_feature",
                        "Variant_subtype","dist_to_pheno","cis_trans","local_distant",
                        "local_distance_bp","clump_n_members")))
})) %>%
  mutate(
    Location         = factor(ifelse(local_distant == "Local", "Local", "Distant"), levels = c("Local","Distant")),
    abs_SnpWeight    = abs(SnpWeight),
    Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = c("SNPs","InDels","SVs","CNVs"),
                              labels = c("SNPs","InDels","SVs",CNV_LABEL))
  )

cat("✓ Data clumped, annotated, and combined.\n")
cat("Total eQTLs (one per clump):", nrow(all_clumped), "\n")
cat("\nLocal / distant:\n");  print(table(all_clumped$Genetic_variants, all_clumped$Location))
cat("\nOld cis/trans call (lead variant within 2 kb), for comparison:\n")
print(table(all_clumped$Genetic_variants, all_clumped$cis_trans))
cat("\n")
```

```{r}
  all_clumped <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_clumped)
```

## 1C — effect size across variant types (pairwise Wilcoxon, BH)
```{r fig1c}
ord <- all_clumped %>% group_by(Genetic_variants) %>%
  summarise(m = median(abs_SnpWeight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(m)) %>% pull(Genetic_variants) %>% as.character()
dat_c <- all_clumped %>% mutate(Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = ord))

pw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(dat_c$abs_SnpWeight, dat_c$Genetic_variants, p.adjust.method = "BH")
pw_tab <- as.data.frame(as.table(pw$p.value)) %>% setNames(c("V1","V2","p_adj")) %>% filter(!is.na(p_adj))
# brackets only for comparisons against SNPs (p-values are still BH-adjusted over all pairs)
pairs <- Filter(function(p) "SNPs" %in% p, combn(ord, 2, simplify = FALSE))
pair_labels <- sapply(pairs, function(p) pw_tab %>%
  filter((V1==p[1]&V2==p[2])|(V1==p[2]&V2==p[1])) %>% pull(p_adj) %>% format.pval(digits = 3))
ss_c <- dat_c %>% count(Genetic_variants) %>% mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))
# bracket heights: first just above the largest effect size, then one step per comparison
sig_y_c <- max(dat_c$abs_SnpWeight, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05 + 0.09 * (seq_along(pairs) - 1)

fig1c <- ggplot(dat_c, aes(Genetic_variants, abs_SnpWeight, fill = Genetic_variants)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_text(data = ss_c, aes(Genetic_variants, -Inf, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = -0.5, size = EFF_NLAB_SIZE, fontface = "bold") +
  # every pairwise bracket, stacked above the data (explicit y positions); the y range is
  # set with coord_cartesian, not scale limits, so no bracket or violin tail is dropped
  geom_signif(comparisons = pairs, annotations = pair_labels,
              y_position = sig_y_c, tip_length = 0.01, size = EFF_BRACKET_LWD, textsize = EFF_PVAL_SIZE, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = wrap_cnv) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.1, max(sig_y_c) + 0.08)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variant_colors) +
  labs(x = "Variant type", y = "Absolute effect size") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = EFF_AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"), axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = EFF_AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(fig1c)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_FIG, "Fig1C_effect_size_by_variant_type.tiff"), fig1c,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
```

# Part 6: Figure 2 — Genomic distribution of eQTLs

```{r fig2}
region_levels <- c("Promoter","5' UTR","Start codon","CDS","Stop codon",
                   "3' UTR","Terminator","Intergenic","Other")

simplify_feature <- function(f) {
  if (is.na(f) || f %in% c("", "NA")) return("Intergenic")
  parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(f, ";")))
  parts <- parts[parts != "" & parts != "NA"]
  if (length(parts) == 0) return("Intergenic")
  if (all(grepl("intergenic", parts))) return("Intergenic")
  parts <- parts[!grepl("intergenic", parts)]
  pr <- c(promoter="Promoter", five_prime_UTR="5' UTR", start_codon="Start codon",
          CDS="CDS", stop_codon="Stop codon", three_prime_UTR="3' UTR", terminator="Terminator")
  hit <- pr[names(pr) %in% parts]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return("Other")
  hit[[1]]
}

feature_dist <- all_clumped %>%
  mutate(region = factor(vapply(Causal_Gene_feature, simplify_feature, ""), levels = region_levels)) %>%
  count(Genetic_variants, region, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(Genetic_variants) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(n > 0)

region_colors <- c("Promoter"="#8E44AD","5' UTR"="#3498DB","Start codon"="#6D4C41",
                   "CDS"="#2ECC71","Stop codon"="#F1C40F","3' UTR"="#E67E22",
                   "Terminator"="#E74C3C","Intergenic"="#95A5A6","Other"="#34495E")

feature_dist <- feature_dist %>%
  group_by(Genetic_variants) %>%
  mutate(lab = ifelse(round(pct, 1) == 0, "", paste0(round(pct, 1), "%"))) %>%
  ungroup()

fig2 <- ggplot(feature_dist, aes(x = region, y = pct, fill = region)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ Genetic_variants, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors, name = "Genomic region", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percentage of eQTL variants (%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"), axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black"),
        legend.position = "right")
print(fig2)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_FIG, "Fig2_genomic_region_bar.tiff"), fig2,
       width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")

feature_dist %>% mutate(pct = round(pct, 1)) %>% arrange(Genetic_variants, desc(pct)) %>% print(n = 100)
```



The key changes from the repel approach:

- Dropped `geom_label_repel` entirely — it doesn't work properly in polar/pie coordinates
- Labels are placed using `x = 1.6` in polar space, which puts them just outside the pie edge
- Labels smaller than 2% are suppressed with `lab = ""` to avoid clutter from tiny slices — you can adjust this threshold
- The legend on the right tells viewers which color is which region, so labels only need to show the percentage

# Part 8: Total variant counts from .bim (background for Fig 4 & Fig 5)

```{r bim-counts}
total_variants_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(bim_paths), function(vt) {
  bim <- read.table(bim_paths[[vt]], header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (vt == "CNVs") {
    bim <- bim[bim$V1 != 17, ]   # chr 17 removed, as in read_assoc()
    # CNVs past the S288C chromosome end removed, as in annotate_variant()
    bim <- bim[bim$V4 <= chr_lengths[num_to_roman(bim$V1)], ]
  }
  n <- nrow(bim)
  data.frame(variant_type = ifelse(vt == "CNVs", CNV_LABEL, vt), total_count = n)
}))

eqtl_counts <- all_clumped %>% group_by(Genetic_variants) %>%
  summarise(eqtl_count = n_distinct(SNP), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(variant_type = Genetic_variants) %>% mutate(variant_type = as.character(variant_type))

variant_summary <- total_variants_df %>%
  left_join(eqtl_counts, by = "variant_type") %>%
  replace_na(list(eqtl_count = 0)) %>%
  mutate(pct_of_total        = 100 * eqtl_count / total_count,
         pct_of_eqtl         = 100 * eqtl_count / sum(eqtl_count),
         pct_of_all_variants = 100 * total_count / sum(total_count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(eqtl_count))
print(variant_summary)

# Save summary to data_summary folder
fwrite(variant_summary, file.path(OUT_SUMM, "variant_summary_stats.txt"),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r fig4}

donut <- bind_rows(inner, outer) %>%

  group_by(circle) %>% arrange(circle, desc(variant_type)) %>%

  left_join(data.frame(circle = factor(c("eQTL","Total"), levels = c("eQTL","Total")),
```

# Part 10: Figure 5 — Odds ratio of eQTL enrichment

```{r fig5}
or_one <- function(v) {
  a <- variant_summary$eqtl_count[variant_summary$variant_type == v]
  b <- variant_summary$total_count[variant_summary$variant_type == v] - a
  c <- sum(variant_summary$eqtl_count[variant_summary$variant_type != v])
  d <- sum(variant_summary$total_count[variant_summary$variant_type != v]) - c
  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(a,b,c,d), 2, 2, byrow = TRUE))
  data.frame(VariantType = v, a_eqtl = a, b_not = b, c_oth = c, d_oth_not = d,
             OddsRatio = (a*d)/(b*c), PValue = ft$p.value)
}
or_results <- bind_rows(lapply(c("SNPs","InDels","SVs",CNV_LABEL), or_one)) %>%
  mutate(PValue_FDR = p.adjust(PValue, "BH"),
         Significant = ifelse(PValue_FDR < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
         VariantType = factor(VariantType, levels = c("SNPs","InDels","SVs",CNV_LABEL)),
         # log2 odds ratio: 0 = no enrichment, > 0 enriched, < 0 depleted
         log2OR      = log2(OddsRatio))
print(or_results)

# Save to data_summary folder
fwrite(or_results, file.path(OUT_SUMM, "odds_ratio_enrichment.txt"),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

# Pad the y-axis on the side(s) the bars extend to, so the labels fit
y_pad <- max(abs(or_results$log2OR)) * 0.6
OR_LABEL_SIZE <- 7.5   # OR and p-value labels on the bars, mm

fig5 <- ggplot(or_results, aes(VariantType, log2OR, fill = VariantType)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 1.1, width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1.5) +
  # p-values below the double-precision limit are stored as 0: shown as p<1e-300
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("OR=", round(OddsRatio, 2), "\n",
                               ifelse(PValue_FDR == 0, "p<1e-300",
                                      paste0("p=", format(PValue_FDR, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)))),
                vjust = ifelse(log2OR >= 0, -0.3, 1.3)),
            size = OR_LABEL_SIZE, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(0, min(or_results$log2OR)) - y_pad * (min(or_results$log2OR) < 0),
                                max(0, max(or_results$log2OR)) + y_pad)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variant_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = wrap_cnv) +
  labs(x = "Variant type", y = expression(bold(log[2]~"(Odds ratio)")),
       caption = "Red dashed line = log2(OR) = 0 (no enrichment)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"), axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(fig5)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_FIG, "Fig5_odds_ratio.tiff"), fig5,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
```

# Part 11: Figure 6 — Pleiotropy (traits affected per variant, by type)

```{r fig6}
pleio <- all_clumped %>% group_by(Genetic_variants, SNP) %>%
  summarise(n_traits = n_distinct(Pheno), .groups = "drop")

pleio_summary <- pleio %>% group_by(Genetic_variants) %>%
  summarise(n_variants = n(), mean_traits = round(mean(n_traits), 2),
            median_traits = median(n_traits), max_traits = max(n_traits), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_traits))
print(pleio_summary)

# Save to data_summary folder
fwrite(pleio_summary, file.path(OUT_SUMM, "pleiotropy_summary.txt"),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

kw <- kruskal.test(n_traits ~ Genetic_variants, data = pleio)
cat("Kruskal-Wallis p =", format(kw$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), "\n")
print(pairwise.wilcox.test(pleio$n_traits, pleio$Genetic_variants, p.adjust.method = "BH")$p.value)

fig6 <- ggplot(pleio, aes(reorder(Genetic_variants, n_traits, median), n_traits, fill = Genetic_variants)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variant_colors) + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Variant type", y = "Number of associated traits (log scale)",
       caption = "Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon, FDR corrected") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"), axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"))
print(fig6)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_FIG, "Fig6_pleiotropy.tiff"), fig6,
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
```

# Part 12: Figure 7 — Pleiotropy by variant SUBTYPE (SVs and InDels only)

```{r fig7}
pleio_sub <- all_clumped %>%
  filter(Genetic_variants %in% c("SVs", "InDels"),
         !is.na(Variant_subtype), Variant_subtype != "", Variant_subtype != "Unknown") %>%
  group_by(Genetic_variants, Variant_subtype, SNP) %>%
  summarise(n_traits = n_distinct(Pheno), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = c("InDels", "SVs")))

pleio_sub_summary <- pleio_sub %>%
  group_by(Genetic_variants, Variant_subtype) %>%
  summarise(n_variants   = n(),
            mean_traits  = round(mean(n_traits), 2),
            median_traits= median(n_traits),
            max_traits   = max(n_traits), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Genetic_variants, desc(mean_traits))
print(pleio_sub_summary)

# Save to data_summary folder
fwrite(pleio_sub_summary, file.path(OUT_SUMM, "pleiotropy_by_subtype_summary.txt"),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

kw_sub <- pleio_sub %>%
  group_by(Genetic_variants) %>%
  summarise(
    n_subtypes = n_distinct(Variant_subtype),
    kw_p = if (n_distinct(Variant_subtype) >= 2)
             kruskal.test(n_traits ~ factor(Variant_subtype))$p.value else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(kw_p), "KW: n/a",
                        paste0("KW p = ", format.pval(kw_p, digits = 3))))
print(kw_sub)

sub_order <- pleio_sub %>%
  group_by(Genetic_variants, Variant_subtype) %>%
  summarise(med = median(n_traits), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Genetic_variants, desc(med))
pleio_sub <- pleio_sub %>%
  mutate(Variant_subtype = factor(Variant_subtype, levels = unique(sub_order$Variant_subtype)))

ss_sub <- pleio_sub %>% count(Genetic_variants, Variant_subtype) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

fig7 <- ggplot(pleio_sub, aes(Variant_subtype, n_traits, fill = Genetic_variants)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = ss_sub, aes(Variant_subtype, -Inf, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.6, size = NLAB_SIZE, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = kw_sub, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = PVAL_SIZE, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ Genetic_variants, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variant_colors) + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Variant subtype", y = "Number of associated traits (log scale)",
       caption = "Subtypes ordered by median; Kruskal-Wallis across subtypes within each type") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black"))
print(fig7)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_FIG, "Fig7_pleiotropy_by_subtype.tiff"), fig7,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")

for (vt in levels(pleio_sub$Genetic_variants)) {
  d <- pleio_sub %>% filter(Genetic_variants == vt)
  if (n_distinct(d$Variant_subtype) >= 2) {
    cat("\n== pairwise Wilcoxon (BH),", vt, "==\n")
    print(pairwise.wilcox.test(d$n_traits, droplevels(d$Variant_subtype),
                               p.adjust.method = "BH")$p.value)
  }
}
```

```{r final-summary}
# ===================================================================
# Final Summary Report
# ===================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n")
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Output directories:\n")
cat("├─ Clumped results:        ", OUT_CLUMP, "\n")
cat("├─ Annotations:            ", OUT_ANNOT, "\n")
cat("├─ Figures:                ", OUT_FIG, "\n")
cat("└─ Summaries:              ", OUT_SUMM, "\n\n")

cat("Figures generated:\n")
figs <- c("Fig1A_effect_size_local_distant.tiff",
          "Fig1B_effect_size_per_variant.tiff",
          "Fig1C_effect_size_by_variant_type.tiff",
          "Fig1D_effect_size_by_variant_type_SNPs_InDels_SVs.tiff",
          "Fig2_genomic_region_bar.tiff",
          "Fig3_variant_subtype_bar.tiff",
          "Fig4_donut_eqtl.tiff",
          "Fig5_odds_ratio.tiff",
          "Fig6_pleiotropy.tiff",
          "Fig7_pleiotropy_by_subtype.tiff")
for (fig in figs) {
  cat("  ✓", fig, "\n")
}

cat("\nSummary tables generated:\n")
cat("  ✓ variant_summary_stats.txt\n")
cat("  ✓ odds_ratio_enrichment.txt\n")
cat("  ✓ pleiotropy_summary.txt\n")
cat("  ✓ pleiotropy_by_subtype_summary.txt\n")

cat("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

**Workflow:** association files -> per-gene LD clumping (cached in `clumped/`) ->
annotation (genomic feature, cis/trans within 2 kb, local/distant within 25 kb) -> tables in
`annotations/` -> figures. Step2 (panel A) and Step3 (single-cell verification) read these tables.
